critical.title: Incomplete Security Validation in Redis Pub/Sub Helper
critical.description: The publishEvent method implements basic security validations but lacks comprehensive input sanitization and authentication mechanisms.
recommendations: Implement Redis AUTH token validation for all pub/sub operations
Add message signing/verification for critical coordination messages
Implement comprehensive input sanitization beyond basic pattern matching
Add role-based access control for different message types
Implement audit logging for all security-relevant events

high.title: Missing Access Control in Transparency CLI
high.description: The transparency CLI provides extensive system visibility without proper access controls or authentication.
recommendations: Implement authentication for transparency CLI access
Add role-based permissions for different visibility levels
Implement rate limiting for CLI commands
Add audit logging for transparency system access
Sanitize output to prevent information leakage

high.title: Insufficient Error Handling in Redis Health Monitor
high.description: Error handling in health monitoring could expose sensitive system information and lacks proper security event logging.
recommendations: Implement sanitized error messages for external logging
Add security event logging for connection state changes
Implement exponential backoff with jitter for reconnection attempts
Add circuit breaker pattern to prevent cascading failures
Implement proper logging levels to prevent information leakage
high.epicImpact: Medium - affects system reliability and security

medium.title: Agent Manager Resource Monitoring Gaps
medium.description: Resource monitoring lacks security-focused thresholds and alerts.
recommendations: Implement security-focused resource limits
Add anomaly detection for unusual resource consumption patterns
Implement automatic isolation for compromised agents
Add security event correlation with resource usage

medium.title: Missing Message Encryption
medium.description: Redis messages are transmitted without encryption for sensitive coordination data.
recommendations: Implement Redis TLS for all communications
Add application-level encryption for sensitive message content
Implement key rotation mechanisms
Add message integrity verification
medium.epicImpact: High - affects confidentiality of coordination data

medium.title: Insufficient Audit Trail
medium.description: Comprehensive audit trail missing for transparency and coordination events.
recommendations: Implement immutable audit logging for all transparency events
Add tamper-evident logging mechanisms
Implement log aggregation and security monitoring
Add retention policies and secure log archival

low.title: Missing Security Headers in CLI Output
low.description: Missing security headers for any web-based output from CLI.
recommendations: Add security headers for any web-based output
Implement content security policies
Add XSS protection for rendered content
low.epicImpact: Low - minor web security improvements needed

low.title: Limited Input Validation in Agent Templates
low.description: Agent templates lack comprehensive validation for security parameters.
recommendations: Add comprehensive validation for agent template parameters
Implement bounds checking for array operations
Add input sanitization for user-provided configurations

implementationTimeline.phase1: 2 weeks - Authentication, encryption, basic access controls
implementationTimeline.phase2: 1 month - Error handling, audit trail, security monitoring
implementationTimeline.phase3: 2 months - Advanced controls, automated testing, incident response
